desc:
🚀 Welcome to Guess The Imposter! Complete your tasks, watch your back, and uncover the imposter before it’s too late. Who can you trust?

🛠️ CREWMATE - Complete tasks and work together to survive!
🔪 IMPOSTER - Blend in, sabotage, and eliminate the crew without getting caught!
🚨 Share clues, defend yourself, and vote out suspicious players!
🎭 Create your look with hats, masks, skins, and pets!
👥 Bring your friends but don’t trust them too quickly!

👍 Like and favorite Guess The Imposter to support the game!
💬 Join the community for updates and announcements!

⚠️ Keep it fair! Cheating, exploiting, and abusing glitches are not allowed.

This is an unofficial fan work and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Innersloth, and does not use AI.
